# Geardon

Item level for World of Warcraft: Forever: on every slot of the character and inspect frame, in bags,
bank, loot, quest rewards and at merchants with an upgrade arrow, in tooltips and for your whole group.
Download: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/geardon

The full description is in [README.md](../README.md). Bug reports are welcome as issues.
